#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

struct Tuple {
    long d;
    int x, y, z;
    Tuple(long _d, int _x, int _y, int _z) : d(_d), x(_x), y(_y), z(_z) {}
};

class CGregAndFriends {
public:
    long mod = 1000000007;
    long INF = (long)1e18 + 1;
    vector<vector<long>> nCr;
    vector<vector<vector<long>>> dist, dp;
    int cnt1, cnt2, n, K;
    vector<int> inputValues;

    CGregAndFriends() {
        nCr.resize(100, vector<long>(100, 0));
        dist.resize(200, vector<vector<long>>(200, vector<long>(2, INF)));
        dp.resize(200, vector<vector<long>>(200, vector<long>(2, 0)));
    }

    long f(long p, int a, int b, int c, int d) {
        p = (p * nCr[a][b]) % mod;
        p = (p * nCr[c][d]) % mod;
        return p;
    }

    void solve() {
        cin >> n >> K;

        for (int i = 0; i < 100; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {
                if (j == 0 || j == i)
                    nCr[i][j] = 1;
                else
                    nCr[i][j] = (nCr[i - 1][j] + nCr[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod;
            }
        }

        cnt1 = 0;
        cnt2 = 0;
        inputValues.resize(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            int val;
            cin >> val;
            inputValues[i] = val;
            if (val == 50)
                cnt1++;
            else
                cnt2++;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 200; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < 200; ++j)
                for (int z = 0; z < 2; ++z)
                    dist[i][j][z] = INF;

        dist[0][0][0] = 0;
        dp[0][0][0] = 1;

        queue<Tuple> pq;
        pq.push(Tuple(0, 0, 0, 0));

        while (!pq.empty()) {
            Tuple curr = pq.front(); pq.pop();
            int x = curr.x;
            int y = curr.y;
            int z = curr.z;
            long d = dist[x][y][z];

            if (z == 0) {
                int rem_x = cnt1 - x;
                int rem_y = cnt2 - y;
                for (int i = 0; i <= rem_x; ++i) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= rem_y; ++j) {
                        if (i + j == 0) continue;
                        if (i * 50 + j * 100 > K) break;
                        if (dist[i + x][j + y][z ^ 1] >= d + 1) {
                            if (dist[i + x][j + y][z ^ 1] > d + 1) {
                                dist[i + x][j + y][z ^ 1] = d + 1;
                                pq.push(Tuple(dist[i + x][j + y][z ^ 1], i + x, j + y, z ^ 1));
                                dp[i + x][j + y][z ^ 1] = (dp[i + x][j + y][z ^ 1] + f(dp[x][y][z], rem_x, i, rem_y, j)) % mod;
                            } else {
                                dp[i + x][j + y][z ^ 1] = (dp[i + x][j + y][z ^ 1] + f(dp[x][y][z], rem_x, i, rem_y, j)) % mod;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                int rem_x = x;
                int rem_y = y;
                for (int i = 0; i <= rem_x; ++i) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= rem_y; ++j) {
                        if (i + j == 0) continue;
                        if (i * 50 + j * 100 > K) break;
                        if (dist[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1] >= d + 1) {
                            if (dist[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1] > d + 1) {
                                dist[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1] = d + 1;
                                pq.push(Tuple(dist[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1], x - i, y - j, z ^ 1));
                                dp[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1] = (dp[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1] + f(dp[x][y][z], rem_x, i, rem_y, j)) % mod;
                            } else {
                                dp[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1] = (dp[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1] + f(dp[x][y][z], rem_x, i, rem_y, j)) % mod;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (dist[cnt1][cnt2][1] == INF) {
            cout << -1 << endl;
        } else {
            cout << dist[cnt1][cnt2][1] << endl;
        }
        cout << dp[cnt1][cnt2][1] << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    CGregAndFriends solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
